contract: Initial stat/cwd samples for eligible WORKER and API, exactly one registry helper observation, then final cwd/stat samples for each eligible role.
Unknown roles do not cause guessed PID reads. Directory certificate and per-role comparisons remain separate.

Shared monotonic deadline starts from the caller-provided original time. A latched budget/clock failure discards the certificate and prior MATCH states even when helper error handling sanitizes the exception.
Helper keeps its own two-second and 136-directory-API-call limits. Process sample counts are separate.
readerBoundary: The bridge receives readBounded as an injected dependency. The referenced adapter contains bounded non-following/non-blocking file flags and finally-close, but this review did not integrate or execute that actual reader. Future wiring must preserve those semantics and provenance.
limitations: No actual filesystem/process/host, runner, transport, payload assembly, output projection or output-cap verification.
No MainPID re-query at the end, loaded-source identity, PC readiness, atomicity or no-ABA guarantee.
Synchronous clock checks do not preempt a stalled operating-system call. Dependencies and clock must be trusted and non-reentrant.
COMPLETED means sampling completed, not that every role matched or production is safe.
No production quota, timeout, envelope, restart or restoration approval.
Staging 24-hour, owner-policy and owner-present gates remain separate; PM1-I1 baseline unchanged.
